headline: Kenmare Resources Minded to Recommend $ Abu Dhabi Takeover Bid
summary: Kenmare Resources announced it is minded to recommend an acquisition offer from Abu Dhabi's International Resources Holding (IRH), despite the bid being 28% below a rejected proposal from last year.
why: Kenmare Resources is one of the world's leading producers of titanium minerals, operating the Moma Titanium Minerals Mine in Mozambique.

impacts.name: Kenmare Resources
impacts.why: Shares trade higher after management signals willingness to accept IRH's buyout offer.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Board willingness to accept the acquisition offer provided a strong valuation premium over recent stock prices.
